transcript.t: Tom, I want to learn an instrument. Which one is good?
The trumpet is loud and fun, but it needs a lot of breath.
Maybe not for me. What about the piano?
Great choice, but a real piano is expensive. You could start with an electronic keyboard.
Yes, so you will not disturb your neighbours.
That sounds perfect. I will ask my parents tonight.
Practise for fifteen minutes a day, and you will improve fast.
